patches.summary: Wire pagination.nextCursor and pagination.hasMore paths into list commands.
patches.reason: The OpenAPI parser at parser.go:4295 only walks top-level response properties when scanning for next_cursor / has_more. Tella's REST envelope nests them under {pagination:{...}}, so the parsed Pagination.NextCursorPath and HasMoreField were emitted as empty strings. The template at command_endpoint.go.tmpl:219 threaded those empty literals into paginatedGet, and the loop exited after page 1.
patches.validated_outcome: videos list --all returns all 232 videos across 16 cursor-followed pages instead of stopping at 15.

patches.summary: Route --csv/--quiet/--plain above the piped-output JSON gate; add unwrapResultsArray, printQuiet, printPlain.
patches.reason: The generated gate `flags.asJSON || !isTerminal(...)` conflated 'user chose JSON' with 'stdout is piped, default to JSON'. With pipes (the agent / shell case), explicit format flags were silently rerouted to JSON. Additionally printOutputWithFlags fed CSV/plain renderers an envelope-shaped JSON instead of a flat array, and --quiet returned nil (silent) despite docs saying 'one value per line'.
patches.validated_outcome: videos list --csv --select id,name | head emits CSV header + rows; videos list --quiet --select id emits one ID per line; videos list --plain --select emits tab-separated rows.

patches.summary: Apply the routing-gate fix to all 49 endpoint commands and unwrap envelope before --select / --compact in JSON path.
patches.reason: The previous fix only patched videos/playlists list commands, but the same gate pattern appeared in 49 other endpoint files. JSON+select also needed envelope unwrap so `videos list --json --select id,name` returns populated items instead of {results:{}}.
patches.validated_outcome: 67 of 67 read operations across the full surface produce correct format and content.

patches.summary: Add unwrapSingleEnvelope helper for {resource:{...}}-style single-object envelopes; apply before filterFields/compactFields in 12 *_get*.go files.
patches.reason: unwrapResultsArray only handled array-bearing envelopes ({playlists:[...]}). Tella's GET-by-id wraps the resource in {playlist:{...}} / {video:{...}} / {clip:{...}}. With --select, filterFields ran against the wrapper (no id/name field) and returned empty {results:{}}.
patches.validated_outcome: playlists/videos/clips get --select id,name returns the populated {id,name} object.

patches.summary: Replace `if len(args) == 0 { return cmd.Help() }` with usageErr; add rejectUnknownSubcommand RunE on parent commands.
patches.reason: Two related issues: (1) cmd.Help() returns nil so missing positional args silently exited rc=0 in 51 generated commands; (2) parent commands without Run/RunE are non-Runnable in cobra v1.9.1, so `videos garbage` returned flag.ErrHelp (rc=0) before Args validation could run. Fix: make parents Runnable with a RunE that errors on unknown subcommand.
patches.validated_outcome: playlists update --name x (missing <id>) exits rc=2; videos garbage exits rc=3 with 'unknown command "garbage" for "tella-pp-cli videos"'; bare parents (videos with no subcommand) still exit rc=0 with help.

patches.summary: Add long-form --help text clarifying that videos viewed sources from the webhook event stream, not the Video.views counter.
patches.reason: Empty results from videos viewed against a workspace with real views (622 total) was confusing. The rollup is keyed off video.viewed/video.milestone webhook events, not the API counter — empty results don't mean zero views, they mean no view events have hit the inbox yet.
patches.validated_outcome: videos viewed --help now explains the data source and points users to wire a webhook endpoint.
